direction.grid: 100vw x 100dvh overflow:hidden; rows 48px header / 52px guide / minmax(0,1fr) main / 56px action bar; columns 184px rail / minmax(0,1fr) stage / 360px inspector at 1366x768; stage minimum 55vw x 60vh; no page scroll, internal scroll only in inspector and task lists; interactive targets at least 36px; refit tight panels before reducing type
direction.colorTokens: bg #050705, panel #0B100B, raised #121A12, silver #C5CCD4 for headings and machine bodies, silverDim rgba(197,204,212,.68), border rgba(197,204,212,.22); primary neon #A8F04A with #050705 text, one primary per viewport; stoppedRed #E5484D reserved exclusively for stopped CELL-MILL-2 outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text; official logo immutable black, emerald/neon green and brushed silver at native aspect in exactly two placements: header and opening story, never recolored, cropped, redrawn or duplicated elsewhere
direction.typography: System sans; 24/30 stage title, 15/20 panel title, 13/19 body, 11/14 uppercase micro-labels, 26px tabular metrics; one verb-led instruction and one status sentence per step; minimal narration; enlarge any stage label under 11px to 11px minimum
direction.motion: 160-220ms ease-out for selection and panels; one 240ms route trace on real state change, then static; no loops or pulses; prefers-reduced-motion removes transitions while pattern, marker and text still carry meaning; 2px neon focus ring with 2px offset on every interactive element; pointer style only on enabled controls
direction.components: Header 48px with official logo left and Lock recovery room right; opening story carries the second and final logo placement; step rail from one steps array with aria-current, arrow-key movement and 36-40px targets; guide strip 52px with no duplicate primary; focusable cinematic factory stage SVG; inspector 360px keeping pre-flight route-health checks for nonce and identity visually and semantically separate from the distinct investigation evidence task, with separate headings, status and controls; action bar 56px with Back left, status centre and one primary right; selecting a recovery option opens the typed consent form; skip-to-stage first, then header, rail, guide, SVG nodes, inspector and action bar in tab order; Enter/Space activate, Esc closes, aria-live polite announces results only
direction.visualizations: State-driven 960x540 SVG using real state only: MAT-ALLOY-A held, 40+30=70 units, feasible routes only in neon, silver for idle machines, red only for stopped CELL-MILL-2, never a route through the offline cell; aligned Certificate 120 versus Receiving 80 tracks with DOES NOT MATCH spanning the gap; bidirectional SVG-to-inspector highlighting; persistent Running/Held/Blocked/Offline-Stopped/Feasible-Accepted legend using pattern, marker and text; pending task proposals deliberately untracked until human approval, while blocked prior tasks remain visible beside an approved recovery plan as replacement tasks await approval

fixes.change: Reduce the oversized opening-story hero inside the stage so the Certificate 120 and Receiving 80 tracks, machines and jobs fit without competing focal points at 1366x768; keep the second official logo placement at native aspect.
Enlarge SVG micro-labels such as event ids and hash-chain text to 11px minimum and raise silverDim contrast on the dark green panels.
Tighten the right evidence list to three visible cards with internal scroll and a clearer selected-card focus ring linked bidirectionally to the SVG.

Strengthen separation in the inspector: keep ROUTE HEALTH - PRE-FLIGHT with nonce and identity status as its own grouped control, and INVESTIGATION - SOURCE EVIDENCE as a distinct task with its own heading, status and action.
Make the route selector at least 40px high with a visible 2px focus ring and label the offline sample state in text, not colour alone.
Reduce empty lower stage space by enlarging the factory SVG about 8% within its panel while preserving the legend and event chain.

Keep selecting a recovery option opening the typed consent form; preserve the exact-phrase field, character count and disabled Accept until match, and add aria-live polite feedback only when the phrase becomes valid.
Align the three option rows on one price/finish baseline and enlarge the Select this path targets to 40px.
Prevent the inspector header from clipping at the top by adding 8px top padding inside its internal scroll region.

Make the pending proposal state unmistakable: keep PROPOSED - UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL beside tasks 1-3 and retain the single Approve primary in the action bar, removing visual emphasis duplication in the inspector.
Enlarge task selector tiles 1, 2 and 3 to 40px and show owner, due offset and predecessor on the selected task without extra narration.
Add a visible focus ring to the inspector Approve and Decline buttons matching the action-bar primary.
Preview CELL-MILL-2 going offline with dashed silver outline and PREVIEW text only; reserve full red stopped treatment until the shock is applied, so preview and stopped states are not conflated.
Clarify the consequence line Will invalidate acceptance directly beside the machine selector and keep Apply second shock as the sole primary.
De-emphasise Scenario Management as a quiet text action separated from the shock controls to avoid accidental activation.
Preserve red exclusively on stopped CELL-MILL-2 outline, cross-hatch and OFFLINE-STOPPED text; verify no route or highlight draws through that cell toward JOB-1002.
Again keep pre-flight route health for nonce and identity separate from the investigation evidence task when this screen repeats, with independent status lines.
Mark Split available capacity as constrained with hatch plus text in both the SVG chip and legend so meaning survives reduced motion and grayscale.
Keep the constrained Split option non-selectable with hatch, text reason and no pointer style, while the feasible selected path retains the neon outline.
Make PRIOR ACCEPTANCE INVALIDATED status persistent in the action-bar centre and pair it with the typed consent form so the fresh approval requirement is explicit.
Raise the muted finish/incremental labels on the constrained row to silverDim minimum contrast while keeping it visually inactive.

Keep 3 BLOCKED prior tasks in a separate collapsed group above proposed replacements; label the lower group PROPOSED - UNTRACKED UNTIL APPROVAL so blocked and untracked states coexist beside the approved revised plan.
Reduce nested scroll confusion by giving blocked and proposed lists one shared inspector scroll with sticky group headings.
Ensure Approve revised tasks is the one primary in the action bar and the in-panel Approve button uses secondary styling with the same focus ring.
Sequence the three proof controls explicitly: Verify ledger enabled, Seal encrypted packet disabled until verified, Export independent checkpoint disabled until sealed, each with text status.
Add passphrase requirement feedback as text checklist items that update without colour alone, and keep the field at least 40px high.
Compress the Before-After metrics row slightly so all three proof steps remain visible at 768px height without inspector scrolling.
Keep the completion screen free of any additional logo placement; only the header logo remains here, preserving exactly two placements overall.
Add a single quiet secondary action for reviewing the sealed packet summary while leaving Back as the only other control, with no new primary competing with the completion status.
Make the bottom PACKET SEALED summary wrap within the 56px action bar at narrower widths rather than truncating event count or offline state.
